notes: published_utc is the UTC date of the Incident Report entry (4 Dec 2023 07:08 PST). evidence: start: Mini Incident Report gives the incident start as 8 Nov 2023 07:59 Pacific. end: Same report ends it at 08:07, eight minutes, for all products but Cloud Storage. regions: Later analysis confirmed impact confined to europe-west4 and europe-north1.
notes: published_utc is the UTC date of the Mini Incident Report entry (9 Nov 2023 00:10 PST). The page lists twelve European regions as previously affected, but the report narrows impact to europe-west4 and europe-north1, which are coded. Times converted from US/Pacific as PST (UTC-8). Cloud Storage was impaired longer: about 72 minutes, partial mitigation about 08:30 and full recovery 09:10 Pacific; the resolution update puts its end around 08:30. services_n counts the four products named on the incident page (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Networking, Cloud Load Balancing); the report itself says multiple products.

evidence: start: Mini Incident Report puts the start at 7 Nov 2023 11:51 Pacific. end: Report ends the incident at 15:46, when Compute Engine impact was mostly mitigated. regions: Impact limited to zone us-east4-a after a rack power loss.
notes: published_utc is the UTC date of the Mini Incident Report entry (8 Nov 2023 14:11 PST). Per-service ends: VPC 12:38, Persistent Disk fully 14:10 (status update says 14:42), Compute Engine mostly 15:46 Pacific; a long tail under 1% of Local SSD customers remained. services_n counts VPC, Compute Engine, Persistent Disk and Cloud Networking.

evidence: start: Mini Incident Report starts the incident 17 Oct 2023 18:00 Pacific. end: Every VPC peer circuit was back by 20:58 Pacific, the stated incident end. regions: Connectivity loss affected VMware Engine in australia-southeast1.
notes: published_utc is the UTC date of the Mini Incident Report entry (18 Oct 2023 15:48 PDT). Times converted from US/Pacific as PDT (UTC-7). evidence: start: Incident Report says telemetry showed cross-region packet loss for us-central1 from 03:08 Pacific on 5 Oct 2023. end: Packet loss fully stopped by 10:55 Pacific. regions: Impact covered all virtual routers in us-central1.
notes: published_utc is the UTC date of the Incident Report entry (11 Oct 2023 07:30 PDT). Times converted from US/Pacific as PDT (UTC-7). Intra-region loss from 07:00 to 08:15 was mainly in us-central1-c; us-central1-a is named for blocked Filestore updates. evidence: start: Detailed Description of Impact starts the outage at 23:30 Pacific on 21 Sep 2023. end: Custom rollback finished 23:34 Pacific on 22 Sep, closing an impact of one day four minutes. regions: Location listed is Global; impact was worldwide.
notes: published_utc is the UTC date of the Incident Report entry (28 Sep 2023 10:56 PDT). Times converted from US/Pacific as PDT (UTC-7). The location is Global, so no region code. A snapshot restore at 05:15 Pacific mitigated errors briefly before impact returned; updates from 13:19 say the majority was mitigated; the resolution update says resolved as of 01:10 on 23 Sep. Individual customers saw shorter impact. services_n counts Cloud Load Balancing and Cloud Networking from the incident page; the report text names only Cloud Load Balancing.
